question: Can one native-STA-selected joint repair policy improve matched A0/R1/Tf states without relying on manually selected net IDs or sequentially consuming resources needed by ties?
evidence: Four exported final states contain23905 exact mapped routed connections each. Allfour Tf worst-slack ties are absent from3809 earlier guided contexts. StrongR1 has6 numerically tied connections, including6587/4 and6590/4; their previous joint repair gave native CPD5.85466. Rawcriticality==1 misses all6 R1 ties; per-domain normalization must not substitute for globalCPD rank.
mapping_observer: native_sta_frontier_stage_03/bin/vpr, analysis only; frozen final exports in native_sta_frontier_dev_03. Preserve original router binaries/results.

hypotheses.name: coverage_and_selection
hypotheses.change: Use exact all-connection native atom/domain/slack data. Begin with numerical worst-slack ties on the shared current state, validated against native reported CPD path/domain. Eight float ULPs are only a numerical grouping tolerance; nearcritical0.2ns is a separate exploratory factor, not a permanent bound. No rawcriticality==1 or guide-only filter.
hypotheses.intervention: Compare old one-worst-report targets, all tied targets, and nearcritical groups; same objective/route inputs. Count actionable finite alternatives and path/domain coverage before native proposals.
hypotheses.outcomes: If additional relevant targets have no feasible/relaxed potential, move to another module; if potential appears but current policy misses it, change selection/consumer.

hypotheses.name: independent_vs_joint
hypotheses.change: Generate fixed-tree/free-capacity and endpoint-relaxed witnesses on the same original accepted state. Keep alternative paths when conflicts require diversity; resolve mutual target capacities before reserving resources. Restore all displaced blockers transactionally.
hypotheses.intervention: Independent single-target, plateau sequence, and joint compatible selection use same target pool and complete per-invocation opportunity. Reuse matching completed query records only after graph/targets/prefixes/occupancy/caps/model equivalence checks; log missing/failed/timeout separately.
hypotheses.outcomes: Joint-only gain supports resource coupling; equally successful independent repair favors simpler policy; infeasible blocker restoration leads to changed group/order/objective, not adjacent strength tuning.

hypotheses.name: CPD_objective
hypotheses.change: Evaluate domain-aware timing impact and nearcritical slack of targets and displaced sinks. Do not sum local physical delay gains as CPD. Final native FULL/STA is authoritative; preserve input accepted state on failure. Separate strict CPD acceptance from bounded plateau exploration.
hypotheses.intervention: Compare physical-delay-only vs path/slack-aware candidate ordering on same feasible path pool before native evaluation. Reject unsupported global CPD bounds.
hypotheses.outcomes: If route delay improves but CPD migrates repeatedly, enlarge critical group/path objective or alter intervention site; do not simply increase query precision.

correctness: Actual RRG edges/switches/capacities and all terminal identities retained; static SCC/graph caches reused, dynamic occupancy/current prefix refreshed.
Native physical Tdel, setup/hold STA, congestion and original route status preserved. NonzeroRC requires RC-aware replay or native path evaluation, not the present zeroRC certificate.
Compare entire policy A0/R1/Tf including rejected/failed proposals and full costs. New seeds/circuits follow a stable development policy; no universal improvement claim from oneeltwise seed.
runtime: Record original routingprocess, preparation, querycore/queryprocess, nativeSTA/check and audit separately; nestedtimers not additive. Then replace repeated graph loading/full audits with persistent or in-process state under equivalent decisions and re-time same environment.
success_branch: Postrepair begins from legal routes and cannot alone improve failed-route success. Continue independent matched prelegal failure/scope/guide research.
stopping_policy: No overall date/count/fixedmatrix stop. A branch is revised using mechanism evidence; individual process guards remain.
